adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` never sets a `team` field (it includes `organizer`, `attendees`, `uid`, `location`, etc., but no `team`). Yet `sendAddGuestsEmails` in `email-manager.ts` only sends additional organizer notifications to team members inside `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`. From the diff alone, the only caller (`addGuestsHandler`) does not populate `team`, and it also only loads `booking.eventType: true` (no team include), so `calendarEvent.team?.members` will be falsy and the team-member notification branch will not run—meaning fellow team members won’t receive the “Guests Added” email even though the email manager appears to support it.
